notes.title: Combat Update & Visual Improvements – July 2025
notes.content: [p]We've refined several aspects of the system to deliver a more intense, fluid, and realistic experience:[/p][list][*][p]Improved physics when eliminating zombies: ragdolls are now activated for more natural deaths.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies fall with more force when defeated, depending on the intensity of the final blow.[/p][/*][*][p]New visual effects when hitting skeletons and casting fire spells.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy projectiles now feature more spectacular and clearer visual effects during combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted haptic feedback on swords and shields when attacking, blocking, or deflecting projectiles.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced hit detection: collisions with enemies are now more accurate and satisfying.[/p][/*][*][p]The fearsome spectral spiders in Level 4 are now more aggressive, making the level a real challenge.[/p][/*][*][p]The main menu camera has been slightly zoomed in to improve text readability.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing! We're continuing to improve [i]Tales of Sintra[/i] with every update.[/p]

notes.title: Possibility to change the joysticks for left-handed players.
notes.content:
Although the game already sets the side on which you want to store the weapons to make it more customizable for right or left-handed players. Now it has been added the option to alternate the joysticks to be able to move the right one and rotate with the left one. 

The customization of controls is now total.

notes.title: Improvements in the weapon system
notes.content:
Weapons are now on the belt and visible to the player. This makes it easier to equip them.

You can configure the side of the belt where you want to carry them.

notes.title: Improvements in fights. Change difficulty during gameplay.
notes.content:
[h2][b]COMBAT:[/b][/h2]
- [b]Impact localization has been added[/b]. Aim at the legs, torso, or head. You can now decapitate your enemies.
- [b]Critical hit[/b]. When some enemies are injured, you can finish them off more quickly by cutting off their heads.
- [b]Improved AI[/b]. Enemies no longer always come straight at you. They will now think about their approach. They will stop, move sideways, backward... they will look for a good way to attack you. As long as you don't draw your bow, of course. They may be zombies and skeletons, but they aren't stupid. If you draw your bow, they will come at you without mercy.
- [b]Enhanced enemy response to hits[/b]. Now, depending on the blow, sometimes they won't flinch, sometimes they'll react slightly, and other times they'll recoil significantly to gather momentum and strike back. This adds much more realism to the fights.
- Now, if you block a sword strike with strength and determination, the enemy will be thrown backward.
- Increased the speed of enemy attacks.
- Added more force to the ragdolls. Now, rats will be sent flying if you hit them with a strong sword strike.

[h2][b]CHOOSE DIFFICULTY:[/b][/h2]
- Players can now change the game's difficulty at any time during a playthrough. It's no longer necessary to start a new game to change the difficulty.
- Stuck in a part of the game? Switch to easy difficulty and you're good to go.
- Finding the normal level too easy? No problem, switch to hard or extreme (I don't recommend the latter) and prepare to die... I mean, enjoy.

[h2][b]OTHER:[/b][/h2]
- The spectral spider guardians of the vortex in level 4 are now much more aggressive.
- Adjustments to rune recharge speed in easy mode. Runes recharge faster.
- Visual improvements to explosions in the fight against the ice golem, the guardian of the ice spell.

notes.title: Now you can fight the darkness from your chair. The seated mode arrives
notes.content:
- The possibility of playing while seated has been implemented
- Sensitivity to turning has been reduced. Occasionally, unwanted turns occurred.
- Minor bugs have been fixed

notes.title: Update Notes May 17
notes.content:
-Weapon handling experience has been improved. 
-Weapon physics have been improved for a more realistic feel.

notes.title: Improvements in fights
notes.content:
-Physics have been added to the fights
- When the enemies die they activate the ragdoll or directly fly away in pieces.
-Animations and fight mechanics have been improved to make them more challenging and fun. 
-A "Powerful Attack" has been included to give more dynamism. The enemy can make strong attacks that you can't block with your sword. When your enemy's sword lights up red try to dodge the attack or parry it with the shield.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Ice Spell problem
notes.content: Fixed a bug that caused some players to miss the ice spell when defeating the Hyorgano golem.

notes.title: Release of Tales of Sintra
notes.content:
The wait is over. On February 27th, Ippo Games presents Tales of Sintra: The Dark Vortex. An action and adventure title for Virtual Reality where you'll discover a world consumed by shadows. The forces of evil have unleashed the Dark Vortex, a voracious entity that absorbs and destroys all light in its path, threatening to plunge the world into eternal darkness.

Highlighted Features:

  • Immersive Environments:
Immerse yourself in a world of darkness that comes to life with beautifully detailed environments. From sinister dungeons to imposing fortresses, each corner is meticulously designed to offer a unique visual experience.
  • Versatile Combat:
Master the art of the sword, bow, shield, and spells. Configure your preferred combat style and face a variety of enemies, from undead and ogres to imposing dragons.
  • Challenging Puzzles:
Beyond brute force, players must use their wits to overcome puzzles. Find creative solutions to advance the story.
  • Runes and Spells:
Unlock magical power by collecting runes scattered throughout the world. Face powerful guardians to unlock spells that will change the course of the battle.
  • Duration and Soundtrack:
With a gameplay duration of over 8 hours, Tales of Sintra immerses you in an epic experience backed by more than 35 captivating musical compositions.
  • Price:
Tales of Sintra will be available for 19.99 euros, though it will have a discount during the first few days after its launch.. Can light defeat darkness? Discover it in Tales of Sintra: The Dark Vortex!
